activity: AI: Hearing Human Voices on Hard Questions
measurement_report_note: Per-speaker media-check files retain earlier export metadata. Current exports passed full decode, dimensions, duration, frame-rate and AAC packet-preservation checks; current local report: generated-artifacts/human-voices-verification/media.json.
narration: Nine untouched original interview recordings; no generated voice or time stretching
alignment: Cached local faster-whisper small.en word timestamps; phrase/scene grouping follows real word starts
editorial_changes: Scott: ASR Well, changed to Will, corroborated by the published source question
Robert: five -year -old tokens joined as five-year-old, same timed span
renderer: Shared deterministic Three.js 0.180.0 people-and-action scenes: 77 cue-aligned meaning beats across nine voices, clear person/tool roles, question and hope markers, 0.6-second scene dissolves, fixed picture explanations and original gold word follower; matching still fallback when WebGL is unavailable

export.audio: Original normalized AAC stereo packets copied from previous films, unchanged; natural speed

acceptance.all_27_scene_keyframes: reviewed from the new renderer in three contact sheets; generated-artifacts/human-voices-verification/storyboard-1.png through storyboard-3.png
acceptance.live_flow_and_phrase_seek: passed: all nine voices, all four steps available, chapter seek and original-speed playback
acceptance.phone_and_landscape: passed: 390×844 and 844×390, no horizontal overflow; scene/caption screenshots reviewed
acceptance.word_follower: one persistent solid gold element; 180 ms glide; holds ordinary pauses; reduced-motion override
acceptance.all_nine_complete_live_playbacks: passed: original-speed audio completed with Three.js visuals, picture explanations and final word captions; no browser errors
acceptance.all_77_picture_explanations: passed: cue-aligned seeking and accessible descriptions in a phone viewport, including reduced motion
acceptance.all_nine_browser_video_decodes_and_seeks: passed; each new film loaded, sought to 55%, played a decoded frame, paused; 1280×720 at 1×
acceptance.all_18_transitions: deterministic boundary render checks at 0, 0.1, 0.3 and 0.6 seconds; complete perceptual playback not evaluated
acceptance.seek_determinism: passed for every scene after seeking to other voices and back
acceptance.reduced_motion: passed: identical scene pixels at different times within each scene with captions excluded
acceptance.no_webgl_fallback: passed with WebGL forcibly disabled; matching Three.js still and live transcript visible
acceptance.audio_packet_preservation: passed: all nine extracted AAC streams have identical SHA-256 hashes to previous films
acceptance.main_branch_integration: passed: existing lesson UI and projector controls retained; Three.js adapter shared by both
acceptance.projector_controls: passed: playback, keyboard seek, next voice, full screen, reduced motion, phone layout

scenes.title: Finding answers
scenes.meaning: Medical records can be hard to understand.

scenes.title: Six years
scenes.meaning: Kamille waited a long time for a diagnosis.

scenes.title: Could answers come sooner?
scenes.meaning: She wonders whether AI could help doctors find answers sooner.

scenes.title: A father’s question
scenes.meaning: Robert is raising a young son.

scenes.title: Who is in control?
scenes.meaning: He asks who should oversee how AI is used.

scenes.title: What does AI need?
scenes.meaning: He wants openness about data centers and local impact.

scenes.title: What is the mission?
scenes.meaning: She asks what drives AI companies.

scenes.title: Keep thinking
scenes.meaning: She wants her son to develop his own thinking skills.

scenes.title: Partner or replacement?
scenes.meaning: She wonders whether AI can support her writing and ideas.

scenes.title: What stays human?
scenes.meaning: He asks which parts of work should stay human.

scenes.title: A future in physics
scenes.meaning: He worries about his daughter’s future research work.

scenes.title: Less tedious work?
scenes.meaning: He asks whether AI could take over unwanted repetitive jobs.

scenes.title: Growing up with AI
scenes.meaning: His children will grow up in a world with AI.

scenes.title: Room to create
scenes.meaning: He wonders how AI could affect children’s imagination.

scenes.title: More time together?
scenes.meaning: He hopes for more time with his daughters.

scenes.title: Stay connected
scenes.meaning: She worries that technology could isolate people.

scenes.title: Our shared humanity
scenes.meaning: She wants people to keep caring for one another.

scenes.title: A place for everyone
scenes.meaning: She asks whether everyone can access the benefits.

scenes.title: The human part
scenes.meaning: She values empathy and the beautiful parts of life.

scenes.title: Lives that feel fulfilled
scenes.meaning: She hopes AI will help loved ones and future generations.

scenes.title: Could AI bring us closer?
scenes.meaning: She wonders whether AI could help humans show more empathy.

scenes.title: The cost to our world
scenes.meaning: She worries about environmental and community harm.

scenes.title: Finding a balance
scenes.meaning: She asks how technology and community safety can coexist.

scenes.title: Help instead of harm?
scenes.meaning: She wonders whether AI could help the environment.

scenes.title: Growing into independence
scenes.meaning: She hopes tools can support her son as he becomes an adult.

scenes.title: A life of his own
scenes.meaning: She asks how AI could support an independent life.

scenes.title: Support in everyday life
scenes.meaning: She wonders whether AI could help her as a teacher and parent.
